di.text:
The effect creation starts here! Change the number to vary the effect's intensity.
If you want to remove the variable, just be wary of values higher than 20.

c*.text: This is the effect's width and height. The higher a number is than the other, the more zoom particles that will spawn on that axis.

c;.text: Make sure you set this to point to the center or something
